question: Find the greatest possible length which can be used to measure exactly the lengths 42 m, 63 m and 140 m.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find HCF of 42, 63, 140

42 = 2 × 3 × 7, 63 = 3 × 3 × 7, 140 = 2 × 2 × 5 × 7

Common factor = 7

Highest common factor = 7

**∴ Answer = 7 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lengths = 42 m, 63 m, 140 m

**Formula used:**

Greatest length = HCF of given numbers

**Calculation:**

⇒ Prime factorization:

⇒ 42 = 2 × 3 × 7

⇒ 63 = 3 × 3 × 7

⇒ 140 = 2 × 2 × 5 × 7

⇒ Common factors = 7

⇒ HCF = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

Largest number that divides all given numbers exactly

Prime Factorization Method

Find common prime factors with smallest powers

Division Method

Repeated division to find HCF efficiently

Application

Used in cutting materials into largest equal pieces
